sentence: This project studies how a reactive gas changes the cutting speed and heat damage when a laser cuts Nitinol.
This project studies how to grow, make and measure materials at the nanoscale.
This project studies how much female crickets differ in choosiness for male song and how much genes explain it.
This project builds a chip system with human cancer and heart tissue and artificial intelligence to predict responses to anti-cancer drugs.
This project builds small robots that learn to move using electronic networks of neurons and synapses inspired by mammals.
This project changes copper-dependent enzymes so they can link amino acid side chains in peptides more effectively.
This project builds computer tools to predict how plasma and materials behave under extreme conditions.
This project builds a framework that uses deep learning to set up parallel code so it runs faster on the computer hardware.
This project studies materials that give sharper X-ray medical images and ways to make metals from hot sulfur-based liquids.
This project studies how a teaching approach that joins biology and engineering affects interest and learning in science.
This project builds methods to undo the hiding of malware that uses virtual machines.
This project designs plant proteins that can be programmed to bind chosen RNA sequences in human cells.
This project studies how vertebrates recovered after a mass extinction, using fossils.
This project studies how likely reservoirs are to drop too low to make power in a warming climate.
This project builds a software tool that tests mental health and suggests matching mental health resources.
This project designs and tests lubricants modeled on natural mucins to protect and lubricate biological systems.
This project brings computer scientists and law scholars together to discuss cybersecurity, privacy and the legal side of computer technology.
This project builds statistical methods to measure how earthquake damage to nearby buildings is linked, and uses this to plan inspections.
